ocr_cases.title: PP1 OCR Warm-Up Poster
ocr_cases.body: This unscored synthetic poster warms a provisioned local OCR engine before measured cases. The benchmark records no participant names, credentials, URLs to fetch, or workflow instructions.

ocr_cases.title: Bushfire Sensor Network — RMIT 2026
ocr_cases.body: Background: regional crews need timely, local indicators during severe weather. Solution: bounded LoRaWAN nodes report temperature, humidity and particulate readings. Evaluation: the prototype compares alerts against a synthetic Australian summer scenario and records CRC-32 integrity checks.

ocr_cases.title: Drought-Ready Water Analyser
ocr_cases.body: Aim: help community gardens compare soil moisture without cloud services. Method: a local analyser samples three probes and reports daily medians. Result: volunteers can inspect trends, annotate maintenance and export a bounded summary for later human review.

ocr_cases.title: EV Charging: Grid-Aware Scheduling
ocr_cases.body: Problem: unmanaged charging produces a sharp evening peak. Design: the scheduler allocates thirty-minute windows while drivers retain final control. Evidence: a synthetic feeder trace shows lower peak demand without claiming production-scale performance.

ocr_cases.title: LoRaWAN Crop-Moisture Mapper
ocr_cases.body: The mapper combines bounded field samples with offline map tiles prepared by an operator. Small labels describe sensor zones, battery status and calibration dates. No document text is interpreted as a command or network location.

ocr_cases.title: Queensland Flood-Forecast Dashboard
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic rainfall totals feed a local dashboard for teaching exercises. The interface shows gauge history, catchment status and a clear uncertainty note. Moderate JPEG compression tests thin punctuation and mixed font sizes without hiding the title.

ocr_cases.title: Coastal Erosion “Twin”
ocr_cases.body: The demonstrator aligns deidentified shoreline profiles across four synthetic survey dates. A digital twin view highlights retreat, dune recovery and measurement tolerance. Decorative quotation marks and low-contrast panels test faithful local text recovery.

ocr_cases.title: Wi-Fi 6E Indoor Positioning
ocr_cases.body: A bounded laboratory trace compares received signal strength at twelve marked positions. The prototype runs locally and reports median error in metres. Mild speckle noise exercises near-character recognition around Wi-Fi, 6E and numeric labels.

ocr_cases.title: AI-Enabled Waste-Sorting Robot
ocr_cases.body: A camera model proposes one of four recycling categories, but a person confirms every uncertain item. The poster reports a synthetic confusion matrix and local inference time. OCR remains the benchmarked capability; this fixture does not claim the sorting rules prove AI readiness.

ocr_cases.title: Microgrid Health Monitor: Stage 2
ocr_cases.body: Local telemetry describes voltage stability, inverter temperature and battery state of charge. The second stage adds bounded anomaly flags and a staff-facing explanation. Results use synthetic traces and do not authorise automatic maintenance actions.

ocr_cases.title: Students’ Safe-Route Planner
ocr_cases.body: The planner compares well-lit paths using synthetic campus segments and accessibility annotations. Students retain control of every route choice. Australian spelling, a curly apostrophe and a compound title test the fixed normalisation policy.

ocr_cases.title: Zero-Trust Lab Access — PKCE
ocr_cases.body: A local demonstrator issues short-lived teaching tokens and records bounded audit events. PKCE protects the synthetic sign-in flow; no real identity provider or credential is used. Compression challenges thin capital letters without changing the security boundary.

ocr_cases.title: Net-Zero Building CO₂ Audit
ocr_cases.body: The audit combines synthetic electricity, gas and occupancy readings. A bounded report distinguishes measured values from estimates and retains staff authority. Small body text, a subscript character and three columns expose recognition and page-order limits.

ocr_cases.title: Urban Heat Island Explorer
ocr_cases.body: Synthetic surface temperatures illustrate how shade, roofs and paving affect a neighbourhood model. The poster title intentionally differs from the supplied metadata by one material character sequence. That mismatch must never become automatic agreement.

ocr_cases.title: AI-Enabled Fire Warning System
ocr_cases.body: This synthetic control changes one material word while preserving the surrounding title. The document discusses heat and smoke indicators, not river levels. Exact or fuzzy OCR output cannot grant identity authority over the mismatch.

ocr_cases.title: Solar Microgrid Analyser
ocr_cases.body: A local analyser compares synthetic photovoltaic output with bounded household loads. The poster uses Australian spelling deliberately. Staff review remains authoritative when OCR substitutes a valid but different spelling or drops a letter.

ocr_cases.title: C++ Telemetry—CRC-32 & MQTT
ocr_cases.body: The embedded demonstrator publishes bounded synthetic sensor frames to a local MQTT broker. CRC-32 checks reveal damaged packets and a C++ parser rejects malformed lengths. Dense punctuation and narrow capitals test exact title recovery.

native_controls.title: Native PDF Regression Control
native_controls.body: Born-digital text should remain the deterministic first path and recover this synthetic title exactly.

native_controls.title: Accessible Timetable — 2026
native_controls.body: A second synthetic control includes two columns, punctuation and a number without requiring OCR.

native_controls.title: Water-Sensitive Campus Design
native_controls.body: A three-column native control preserves extraction behaviour while the benchmark evaluates OCR separately.

native_controls.title: Students’ Energy Dashboard
native_controls.body: Curly punctuation is represented in the synthetic ground truth and remains a native-path regression control.
